## Executive Summary

- Chet Atkins was a musician, songwriter, and producer.
- Chet Atkins' genres included pop and rock.
- Chet Atkins is considered one of the greatest guitarists of all time.
- Chet Atkins produced hit records for Dolly Parton, Elvis Presley, the Everly Brothers, Jerry Reed and Waylon Jennings.
- Chet Atkins died on June 30, 2001, at the age of 77.
- Blitzkrieg Bop is a song by Ramones.
- Köşebaşı is a song by Yüzyüzeyken Konuşuruz, released Jul 23, 2023.
- Kafama Göre is a song by Athena, released May 10, 2021.
- Follow Your Fire is a song by Kodaline, released Apr 6, 2018.
- Crawl by Barenaked Ladies has a BPM of 194.0 and was released in 2013.
- Must Get Out by Maroon 5 has a BPM of 194.0 and was released in 2003.
- Stage by Live has a BPM of 194.3 and was released in 1994.
- Decode by Paramore is a Pop Rock song in B Minor.
- Dance, Dance by Fall Out Boy is a Pop Rock song in B Minor.
- Chet Atkins was a great chicken-picker but he got into more of that jazz fusion type of guitar.
- Steve Wariner could really play the country thing.
- Keith Urban was really doing the rock 'n' roll thing.
- There's been an evolution of guitar in country music.
- David Gilmour is a producer and songwriter for Pink Floyd.
- David Gilmour wanted a bright, powerful lead guitar tone that would basically rip your face off.
- A 53 year studio veteran Nashville session guitarist played on over 600 albums as listed on Allmusic.com since his pro-session debut in 1976 with Eddie Rabbitt.
- Steve Winwood's first instrument that he learned to play was the piano.
- At age 15 Steve Winwood dropped out of school to join his brother in a rock band, the Spencer Davis Group.
- Steve Winwood's father was a foundry worker and part-time musician.
- Steve Winwood's first public vocal performance was in his church choir.
- As a teenager Steve Winwood learned the bass, guitar, and drums while immersing himself in American blues and the new sounds of rock and roll.
- Keith Urban is a singer, songwriter, guitarist, and producer.
- Keith Urban was born on 26 October 1967 in Whangārei, New Zealand.
- Keith Urban's origin is Caboolture, Queensland, Australia.
